records.quote: mitto, mlsi, missum, 3 (contr. form,  misti for misisti, Cat. 14, 14: archaic inf.  pass, mittier, Plaut. Capt. 2, 3, 78), v. a.  [etym. dub. ; cf Sanscr. math-, to set in  motion], to cause to go, let go, send, to send

note: L&S mitto, misi, missum 释义 "to cause to go, let go, send, to send off, despatch"，与 mittere「送」一致；分词词干 miss- 见 rx-miss。
